title: Past a mute, a message without a mention of the viewer leaves the row as it is, with no re-read
why: RisingWave keeps a muted channel or DM row at its last message before the mute: the muted prefix's latest_seq stops at mute_from_seq (rw_inbox_muted_prefix_v2) and rw_inbox_serving_v9 shows it as the row's latest_activity_seq. A message past the mute (moves: false) that does not mention the viewer changes nothing and asks for no re-read; the next answer, still at 100, is not older than the row. Decided: Tenny, #triage:#244, 2026-11-16 (follow RisingWave).

web: packages/web/src/store/socketBridge.ts (isMessageActivitySuppressedByMute: such a message does not reach Activity)
